MEMO TO THE BOARD OF [AUTHORITY]

Re: Taxable revenue bond and PILOT for [COMPANY]'s [PROJECT] in [COUNTY]

Staff recommends approval of a taxable revenue bond to fund $12,000,000 of project cost. To cover 2.0% issuance costs paid from proceeds, par is set at $12,245,000 (rounded up to the next $5,000). The bond carries a 4.50% fixed rate over 20 years, with the first 24 months interest-only at $45,918.75 per month, followed by 216 level payments of about $82,815.95. Total interest over the term is about $6,745,295.

On projected net operating income of $1,500,000 per year, amortization-period debt service coverage is about 1.51x.

The PILOT covers real property of $18,000,000 and equipment of $9,000,000, which depreciates 10% of original cost per year to a 20% floor (year-3 value $6,300,000). At a 40% assessment ratio, full combined tax is $291,276 in year 1 and $225,720 in year 8. The ten-year abatement declines from 100% to 10%; the year-6 PILOT payment is $123,120. Total abated tax over ten years is $1,447,740, with a present value of about $1,210,578 at 5.0%. For 150 jobs at $52,000, this equals about $9,652 abated per job.

Staff requests board direction on [AUTHORITY] approvals.

yearly abated amounts discounted at 5%, end of year
